test_cases.name: loads_writing_for_agents_first
assertions: Loads .agents/skills/agentic-os/writing-for-agents/SKILL.md for the writing style guide before analysis

test_cases.name: reads_primary_sources_not_memory
assertions: Reads the session log for the given id from disk
Does NOT rely on memory of the session

test_cases.name: empty_input_uses_current_session_logs
assertions: Reads the current session's logs on this machine
Does NOT ask for a path before trying the current session

test_cases.name: covers_seven_categories
assertions: Looks for candidates in navigation, automated checks, coding standards, global AGENTS.md, tool economy, no-ops, and information access
Treats the absence of any lint/typecheck/test guardrail as a finding

test_cases.name: candidates_have_evidence_change_location
assertions: Each candidate states what happened with session evidence, the proposed change, and where it goes

test_cases.name: mechanical_rule_goes_to_check_not_standards
assertions: Proposes a deterministic check for a mechanical rule

test_cases.name: stops_until_user_picks
assertions: Does NOT apply any change until the user picks
